paragraph: [In July 2026 the tax authority AGT directed that taxes be paid electronically as a rule, through its taxpayer portal](<https://valoreconomico.co.ao/artigo/fim-do-papel-agt-exige-via-digital-para-pagamento-de-impostos-e-reclamacoes>). Expansão, from EMIS data, [put payments through RUPE in 2025 at about Kz 6.7 trillion](<https://expansao.co.ao/economia/detalhe/pagamentos-via-rupe-ja-valem-36-das-receitas-correntes-do-estado-70130.html>), roughly 36% of Kz 18.9 trillion of current revenue, oil taxes excluded. [In 2025 the UN's global survey on trade facilitation reported electronic payment of customs duties in Angola as partially implemented](<https://www.untfsurvey.org/economy?id=AGO>). In the last twelve months, the July 2026 directive is the change found. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically.

The OBR says [taxes have been declared and paid online through the Umutangakori portal since August 2023](<https://abpinfo.bi/2023/12/01/lancement-officiel-des-activites-de-celebration-de-la-8eme-edition-de-la-journee-dediee-aux-contribuables/>), with receipts issued electronically. In the last twelve months, [on 19 January 2026 the OBR launched e-KORI for online tax filing and payment of taxes and fees](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/01/22/burundi-modernizes-tax-and-non-tax-revenue-collection-with-ekori-launch>). [In June 2026 the finance and digital economy minister said E-Kori already allows online filing and payment for some taxpayers](<https://burundi-eco.com/le-gouvernement-accelere-t-il-la-digitalisation-des-services-publics/>). No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[In March 2026 a release said taxpayers can declare and pay taxes online, by automated bank transfer or mobile money](<https://anssfd.bj/benin-la-digitalisation-des-paiements-publics-double-les-ressources-de-letat-et-accelere-linclusion-financiere/>). Receipts are instant. [In March 2026 a release said nearly a third of state revenue was collected through digital channels](<https://anssfd.bj/benin-la-digitalisation-des-paiements-publics-double-les-ressources-de-letat-et-accelere-linclusion-financiere/>). [The tax directorate's 2025 activity report puts electronic payments above 96% for most taxes, mostly from medium and large firms](<https://ictd.ac/general/benins-e-tax-rollout-small-businesses-digital-public-infrastructure/>), ICTD reports. In the last twelve months, [Decree 2026-617, signed on 18 September 2026, requires fees for justice chancellery and court acts, tax stamps included, to be paid only electronically](<https://sgg.gouv.bj/doc/decret-2026-617/>). No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically.

[In November 2026 the tax directorate's eSINTAX JAVA portal took tax returns and payments online](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article150547>). [In January 2025 the Faso Arzeka platform took customs duties by app, web and USSD](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/solutions/burkina-faso-launches-digital-payment-platform-to-streamline-government-services>). In the last twelve months, the eSINTAX portal opened, and [in September 2026 Orange said public-administration payments can be made directly in Max It](<https://burkina24.com/2026/09/21/orange-burkina-faso-lance-la-nouvelle-version-de-son-application-max-it/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for revenue paid electronically. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives a share or an amount of revenue paid electronically.

Botswana's record shows that [in February 2024 the finance minister listed online tax filing and electronic payment among BURS e-services in operation](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/77665>). In the last twelve months, [Andersen says Botswana's tax rules in force from 1 July 2026 make electronic billing and invoicing mandatory](<https://bw.andersen.com/botswanas-new-tax-rules-take-effect/>). The rules support tax administration with digital filing, and compliance deadlines are still to apply. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[On 24 March 2025 the tax administration launched e-Tax for online tax information, declaration and payment, per Agence Ecofin](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2503-126985-la-centrafrique-lance-officiellement-e-tax-sa-plateforme-de-paiement-d-impots-en-ligne>). [In August 2025 the finance minister said taxes are to be paid online through e-Tax](<https://ecomatin.net/fiscalite-bangui-menace-de-sanctionner-les-grandes-entreprises-qui-boudent-la-plateforme-e-tax>), and over half of the large taxpayers concerned did not yet use it. In the last twelve months, [Orange Centrafrique, Webb Fontaine and NGSER launched payment of the DPI customs fee through Orange Money](<https://investirencentrafrique.com/2026/07/03/orange-centrafrique-et-webb-fontaine-lancent-le-paiement-automatise-de-la-redevance-dpi-via-orange-money/>). Receipts pass in real time to the SYDONIA customs system. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[The finance ministry says online filing and online payment of taxes and duties have operated since 2017](<https://finances.gouv.ci/gouvernance-et-reformes/fiscalite-interieure>). The finance minister says [collections through TresorPay reached FCFA 36 billion from 2.5 million transactions in 2024](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2025/09/15/cote-divoire/economie/cote-divoire-modernisation-des-finances-de-letat-le-tresor-public-accroit-ses-performances-grace-a-un-systeme-de-digitalisation-efficace-et-transparent_190194.html>), against FCFA 3 billion in 2021. TresorPay is the Treasury's e-payment platform. The last twelve months bring one dated change: [in October 2026 the BCEAO said Treasuries on PI-SPI can receive taxes and duties from any account](<https://www.bceao.int/fr/communique-presse/connexion-des-tresors-publics-la-plateforme-interoperable-du-systeme-de-paiement>). The open question is the share of all revenue paid electronically, because the figure found covers TresorPay collections only.

In March 2026 Visa's country manager said [customs duties paid with the GUCE x BGFIBank Business Card are now paid fully digitally](<https://haurizonnews.com/vers-une-douane-sans-cash-visa-bgfibank-le-guce-et-trustpayway-misent-sur-la-digitalisation-du-paiement>). In June 2026 an editorial said [the tax directorate has for several years taken tax declarations and payments online](<https://actucameroun.com/2026/06/02/recouvrement-des-impots-locaux-le-coup-de-pouce-salutaire-de-ladministration-fiscale/>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [taxpayers at a Yaoundé tax centre could pay tax notices through Tresor Pay or by MTN MoMo and Orange Money](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/cameroun-la-dgi-simplifie-le-paiement-des-avis-dimposition-via-mtn-momo-orange-money-otp-et-tresor-pay/>). Receipts were printed at once. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for revenue paid electronically. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives a share or an amount of revenue paid electronically.

Kinshasa's provincial revenue directorate [launched irms-dgrk.com on 5 March 2026](<https://deskeco.com/2026/03/06/kinshasa-la-dgrk-lance-la-plateforme-irms-dgrkcom-pour-la-declaration-et-le-paiement-des-impots-en>) for filing and paying provincial taxes online. Tshopo province [launched Veri-Gov on 21 August 2026](<https://www.opinion-info.cd/politique/2026/08/21/tshopo-le-gouvernement-lance-veri-gov-une-plateforme-pour-payer-les-impots-et>) for paying provincial taxes by mobile phone. Nationally, [a ministerial circular of 18 January 2024 lets banks and e-money institutions collect central-government taxes, customs duties and fees through digital channels](<https://droitnumerique.cd/modalites-dutilisation-des-canaux-digitaux-dans-le-processus-de-paiement-des-recettes-fiscales-non-fiscales-et-douanieres-en-rd-congo/>). Both provincial platforms were launched in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[Arrêté no. 1009 of 22 May 2026 makes payment of public revenue exclusively electronic through the Fouta platform](<https://sgg.cg/JO/2026/congo-jo-2026-24-2.pdf>). [Since 3 August 2026 taxpayers file on the E-Tax or Sydonia platforms and pay taxes, levies and customs duties online through Fouta](<https://leconomie.info/congo-le-paiement-des-impots-et-taxes-bascule-en-ligne/>), L'Economie reports. In the last twelve months, on 17 November 2026 the finance minister [told the National Assembly that FOUTA had collected nearly FCFA 107 billion since 1 June](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/fr/articles/questions-orales-avec-d%C3%A9bat-AN_171126>). That was FCFA 94 billion of taxes through e-Tax and FCFA 13 billion through SYDONIA. Its predecessor e-Pay had brought in about FCFA 1 billion. The ministry [put the total at 8.5% of 2026 tax revenue](<https://ecomatin.net/congo-107-milliards-fcfa-de-recettes-publiques-collectes-par-la-nouvelle-plateforme-de-paiement>).

[On 15 April 2026 the Directorate General of Taxes launched a three-day workshop](<https://finances.gouv.km/actualite_post/atelier-dgi-au-retaj-sur-la-validation-du-cadre-juridique-des-teleprocedures-fiscales-2026/>). [AFD's PAGFSI project funded it, to validate the legal framework for fiscal teleprocedures](<https://finances.gouv.km/actualite_post/atelier-dgi-au-retaj-sur-la-validation-du-cadre-juridique-des-teleprocedures-fiscales-2026/>). [It prepared the progressive rollout of tax e-filing (télédéclaration) and e-payment (télépaiement)](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260520073604/http://dgi.gouv.km/fr/actualite.php?article_id=93>), under the 2026 finance law. In the last twelve months, the workshop is the step found. No source found since October 2023 says some taxes or fees can be paid electronically. Establishing would need electronic payment in service for some taxes or fees.

[In May 2024 the tax directorate (DNRE) said tax returns are submitted and taxes paid through its portal](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/-/funcionamento-do-portal>). In the last twelve months, [in 2026 the DNRE's online customs clearance page took payment by DUC reference](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/pagamento-online-de-despacho>), which adds online payment of customs duties to the 2024 tax portal. [It accepts Vinti4 or Visa cards issued by Cabo Verdean banks, with SISP one-time-password security](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/pagamento-online-de-despacho>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for revenue paid electronically. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives a share or an amount of revenue paid electronically.

[In 2025 the World Bank committed US$20m to the Djibouti Economic and Financial Governance Project](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P180696>). [It sets a target of 70% tax e-filing adoption by December 2029](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P180696>). [At the January 2026 review that indicator stood at 0%](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P180696>). In the last twelve months, that review is the one reading found. No source found since October 2023 says some taxes or fees can be paid electronically. Establishing would need electronic payment in service for some taxes or fees.

[Since 25 July 2026 the tax directorate's Jibayatic portal has been open to all taxpayers for remote payment of taxes](<https://ouest-tribune.dz/direction-generale-des-impots-lancement-du-paiement-electronique-a-distance-des-impots-via-le-portail-jibayatic/>). [Its guide says any tax, duty or levy declared online there can be paid online](<https://www.upgrowth.dz/actualites/paiement-impots-en-ligne-algerie-guide-jibayatic-dgi>). In the last twelve months, the portal opened to all taxpayers. In February 2024 [customs e-payment procedures were still being finalised](<https://ouest-tribune.dz/numerisation-du-secteur-des-finances-les-applications-et-plateformes-ont-permis-de-realiser-des-progres-notables/>). No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[The Ministry of Finance gives EGP 2.5 trillion of e-payment and collection for July 2023 to May 2024](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/3/12/525882/Business/Economy/Epayment,-collection-services-in-Egypt-rise-to-EGP.aspx>). Electronic tax collection was EGP 613.1 billion and customs collection EGP 284.3 billion. [In January 2024 it put e-payment and collection since May 2019 at EGP 8.1 trillion in 607.3 million transactions](<https://dailynewsegypt.com/2024/01/04/e-payment-collection-services-exceed-egp-8-1trn-in-egypt-finance-minister/>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026 Finance Minister Ahmed Kouchouk said [real-estate transaction tax can be paid by bank card through the Tax Authority's Real Estate Transactions app](<https://www.fintechgate.net/250244>). [In November 2026 Orange Egypt said guardians can pay family-prosecution fees through Max it and Orange Cash](<https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/14/%D8%A3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%86%DA%86-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B3%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%88%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%AF%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%AE%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B0%D9%83%D8%A7%D8%A1%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%B7%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%AD%D9%84%D8%A9%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9%D9%85%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86/7618130>).

[In July 2026 Ethio telecom said taxpayers can pay the federal Ministry of Revenues and twelve regional and city revenue authorities through telebirr](<https://techtrends.africa/ethiopia-expands-mobile-tax-payments-nationwide-through-telebirr/>), by app or USSD. [In June 2024 Webb Fontaine said electronic payment had been introduced in the Webb Customs system](<https://webbfontaine.com/success-stories/ethiopia/customs-management-project>). [In October 2026 EthSwitch presented a Unified Government Payment Platform, a single route through the national switch for government bills](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/01/ethswitch-unified-government-payment-platform/>). In the last twelve months, that presentation and the July 2026 telebirr arrangement are the changes found. No source found since October 2023 says the main domestic taxes are filed and paid electronically nationwide. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[On 10 July 2025 the tax directorate and Moov Africa launched payment of taxes by Moov Money for taxpayers with turnover under FCFA 30 million](<https://www.gabonreview.com/e-tax-le-gabon-passe-au-paiement-mobile-des-impots/>). In the last twelve months, from October 2026 [eTax is part of Gabon Connect, and TrésorPay takes some non-tax revenue](<https://gabonmediatime.com/digitalisation-le-gouvernement-annonce-le-deploiement-progressif-de-gabon-connect/>), GabonMediaTime reports. [The tax directorate says online payment of oil, mining and forestry revenue starts in October 2026, rolling out to December 2027](<https://dgi.ga/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Flyer-Gabon-Connect-%E2%80%93-Rencontre-FEG.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

In May 2024 President Akufo-Addo said [transactions worth some GH¢1.6 billion had passed through the Ghana.gov portal](<https://3news.com/featured/ghanas-e-initiatives-good-model-for-digital-transformation-in-africa-akufo-addo>) since its launch in 2019. From May 2021 the revenue authority said [domestic taxpayers pay on the Ghana.gov platform](<https://gra.gov.gh/cashless-policy/>). In the last twelve months, from 1 November 2026 [Ghana Police say traffic fines notified by their TraffiTech-GH cameras can be paid by mobile money or card](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/ghana-la-police-deploie-des-cameras-connectees-pour-automatiser-le-controle-routier>). [The Bank of Ghana's fintech report for the first quarter of 2026 lists wallet payments to government as in service](<https://www.bog.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/FinTech-Sector-Report-2026-Q1-2.pdf>). The Ghana.gov figure is a running total since 2019. The open question is whether the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically.

[On 22 December 2025 Guinea launched Tresor Pay for paying administrative fees and charges owed to the state by mobile phone](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/finance/guinea-rolls-out-tresor-pay-as-digital-gateway-for-public-payments>). [In May 2026 We are Tech reported the government had launched eTax for online declaration and payment of taxes](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/la-guinee-lance-neuf-chantiers-numeriques-pour-moderniser-l-administration>). Tresor Pay and eTax were both launched in the last twelve months. [On 14 September 2026 the territorial administration minister, Djenabou Touré, announced digital tax payment in Guinea's markets, with no date or system named](<https://vision224.com/guinee-djenabou-toure-annonce-la-digitalisation-du-paiement-des-taxes-dans-les-marches/>). No source found since October 2023 says customs duties are paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

In April 2026 [the Accountant General said citizens and businesses can pay taxes, fees and levies through GovPay](<https://standard.gm/aps-wallet-partners-accountant-generals-department-to-enhance-digital-revenue-collection/>), the government payment gateway. In the last twelve months, [A July 2026 agreement added SUTURA for taxes, fees and other charges](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/accountant-general-seals-pact-with-sutura-to-strengthen-digital-revenue-collection>). In October 2025 the revenue authority [presented its new tax system to stakeholders ahead of nationwide implementation](<https://standard.gm/gra-introduces-itas-system-to-stakeholders/>). [In June 2026 the system was still being introduced ahead of full rollout](<https://standard.gm/gra-hosts-workshop-on-itas/>). No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[A tax directorate circular of 10 December 2025 makes import VAT payable only through Kontaktu](<https://kontaktu.mef.gw/>). In July 2024 O Democrata GB reported on the tax directorate's Kontaktu platform. [It lets taxpayers declare and pay taxes at any time by bank transfer, Orange Money and Mobile Money](<https://www.odemocratagb.com/?p=49407>). In the last twelve months, the circular narrowed import VAT to that platform. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[Presidential Order 3/2025 sets the abandonment of cash collection of certain public revenues](<https://diariorombe.es/tecnologia/muni-dinero-la-plataforma-financiera-de-pastor-hassan-obiang-mangue-creado-con-dinero-publico-que-aspira-a-entrar-en-las-cuentas-del-estado-y-concentrar-informacion-economica-de-los-ciudadanos/>), Diario Rombe reports. In the last twelve months, [on 30 September 2026 the e-money firm Muni proposed its wallet as a channel for state taxes and fees](<https://diariorombe.es/tecnologia/muni-dinero-la-plataforma-financiera-de-pastor-hassan-obiang-mangue-creado-con-dinero-publico-que-aspira-a-entrar-en-las-cuentas-del-estado-y-concentrar-informacion-economica-de-los-ciudadanos/>). The transport ministry said it would study the proposal. No source found says any tax or fee is paid electronically. Establishing would need electronic payment in service for some taxes or fees.

In October 2024 the Treasury Cabinet Secretary [gave eCitizen's collections to the Senate](<https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/economy/state-collects-sh127bn-via-e-citizen-4784244>): Sh26.4 billion in the year to June 2023 and Sh100.8 billion in the year to June 2024. [At least Sh127.2 billion had passed through it](<https://www.businessdailyafrica.com/bd/economy/state-collects-sh127bn-via-e-citizen-4784244>) since all services were ordered paid through one number. [On 27 October 2026 the Treasury's Principal Secretary told the National Assembly Finance Committee that the Treasury manages eCitizen, the government's digital payment platform](<https://www.tnx.africa/national/article/2001560974/national-treasury-pushes-new-regulations-plan-to-run-e-citizen>). In the last twelve months, no later figure than Sh100.8 billion has been found. No source found since October 2023 says customs duties are paid electronically.

[In April 2026 the revenue authority said its LITAS system lets taxpayers register, file returns, generate payment slips and pay in real time](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/lra-hosts-first-digital-symposium-to-showcase-technology-driving-tax-compliance-and-payment-systems/>). [By August 2025 taxpayers could pay through LITAS by mobile money, phone or computer](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/lra-trains-staff-on-new-digital-tax-payment-system/>). [From 1 December 2025 a central bank directive routes all government revenue collected by mobile money, taxes included, through NEPS/IIPS](<https://cbl.org.lr/sites/default/files/documents/NEPS-IIPS%20Directive%20-%20092325.pdf>). In the last twelve months, the directive and the April 2026 LITAS statement are the changes found. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[On 4 December 2025 the finance ministry told customs and tax offices to take amounts over 500 dinars only by certified cheque or electronic payment](<https://sada.ly/en/electronic-payment-500lyd/>). [A decree by Prime Minister Aldabaiba made e-payment an approved method for collecting state revenues and public dues](<https://libyaherald.com/2026/03/aldabaiba-government-and-cbl-take-further-actions-to-encourage-increased-e-payments-use-cbl-reduces-new-fx-bureaux-commission>). Cash and cheques remain approved alongside it. [The finance ministry said the Unified Tax System implements Decision No. 448 of 2025 on tax e-payment and e-collection](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=346934&lang=ar>). In the last twelve months, the instruction and the decree are the changes found. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.

[Revenue Services Lesotho says Corporate Income Tax, PAYE, VAT and customs duties can be paid through the RSL-SLB e-payment system](<https://www.lena.gov.ls/rsl-slb-launch-e-payment-integration>). [In July 2024 it added EcoCash wallet payment of taxes and customs duties through its website](<https://newsdayonline.co.ls/rsl-adds-new-digital-tax-payment-platform/>). [On 11 February 2026 it launched e-payment with Standard Lesotho Bank by USSD, internet banking and the bank's app](<https://www.lena.gov.ls/rsl-slb-launch-e-payment-integration>). In the last twelve months, the February 2026 launch is the change found. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for revenue paid electronically. Mature would need a source from the past three years that gives a share or an amount of revenue paid electronically.

[The DGI says its Simpl teleservices let taxpayers declare and pay taxes electronically (telepayer)](<https://aujourdhui.ma/economie/e-services-la-dgi-etoffe-son-systeme-simpl>). [The DGI's 2025 activity report, as le360 reports it, puts the share of tax revenue paid by tele-payment at 91.4% in 2025, up from 91.2% in 2024](<https://fr.le360.ma/economie/impots-914-des-recettes-fiscales-encaissees-par-telepaiement-en-2025_UYH2TYM6ENA5HCQIPRGMWZML44/>). [It counted 12,304,943 tele-payments in 2025](<https://fr.le360.ma/economie/impots-914-des-recettes-fiscales-encaissees-par-telepaiement-en-2025_UYH2TYM6ENA5HCQIPRGMWZML44/>). In the last twelve months, the 2025 figure of 91.4% is the change found. No source found since October 2023 names customs duties among the revenue filed and paid electronically.

[The Ministry of Economy and Finance says it launched SIGRNF on 9 May 2025](<http://central.mef.gov.mg/page_personnalisee/index/news/1642>). It lets users pay non-tax government revenues 24/7 via mobile banking, with progressive nationwide rollout. In September 2025 the finance minister said [the e-Hetra online tax filing and payment system has been extended nationwide](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-rindra-rabarinirinarison-minister-of-economy-and-finance-of-madagascar>). [SAFI has been in production since September 2025](<https://cabinet-fenitra.mg/actualites/safi-cap-sur-le-deploiement-effectif-a-madagascar/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the main taxes and customs duties are filed and paid electronically. Operating would need the main taxes and customs duties filed and paid electronically.
